newsitem.title: THAILAND: REFERENCE RATE WEAKENS TO 31.618-BANK OF THAILAND.
newsitem.headline: REFERENCE RATE WEAKENS TO 31.618-BANK OF THAILAND.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Thursday said the weighted average interbank exchange rate was 31.618 per dollar against 31.591 on Wednesday.
The reference rate is the average rate traded the previous day. It has been announced daily by the central bank since the July 2 managed flotation of the baht.
The baht was quoted at 31.65/31.85 to the dollar onshore and 30.80/30.90 in offshore markets early.
